tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: Most parameters are within normal limits. Hemoglobin is mildly elevated, which may indicate dehydration, smoking, or less commonly, underlying pathology. Platelet distribution width is also elevated, suggesting increased platelet size variability, which can be seen in reactive states or platelet disorders. Correlation with clinical context and possible repeat testing is recommended if clinically indicated.
